info.name: PMIS API v3.0.0
info.description: OpenProject-compatible Project Management Information System. Authentication via JWT. All project-scoped path params are UUIDs (project_uuid). Catalog modules (vendors, resource_types) seed demo data on first boot.

request.description: Check API health status
Get API root information
Authenticate user and receive JWT access + refresh tokens
Dual-purpose: validates an access token, or rotates an expired access token if a refresh token is also supplied. Public.
Get currently authenticated user
Create a new user (admin only)
List all users with pagination (admin only)
Get user by ID (INTEGER for user_id — users did not migrate to UUID)
Update user details
Update user password
Delete user by ID (admin only)

item.name: Vendors
item.description: Vendor catalog used by the project + milestone vendor pickers. Any authenticated user can read; only admins can write. 5 demo vendors are seeded on first boot.

request.description: List all active vendors. Use the returned ids when attaching vendors to a project / milestone.
Create a vendor (admin). Vendor names are unique.
Edit a vendor (admin). Deactivating (active=false) keeps existing associations intact but prevents new ones.

item.name: Resource Types
item.description: Resource type catalog referenced by activity_resources.type_of_resource_id. Seeded with rfp / asg / ccm.

request.description: List all active resource types. Use the id (NOT the code) as typeOfResourceId on resource-mode activities.
Create a resource type (admin). Codes are unique, lowercase.

item.name: Projects
item.description: Project lifecycle (new/draft/published/closed/suspended) with versioning and soft-delete-with-cascade. Deleting a baseline cascades the soft-delete to every live version of it.

request.description: Create a project. Server generates id (UUID) + projectCode. category must be one of MSIP, MSAP, BSP, others. If 'others', supply categoryOther (see next request). vendorIds is an optional list of vendor UUIDs (fetch via GET /vendors).

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Others Category Project",
  "description": "Demo of category=others with free-text label",
  "owner": "admin",
  "category": "others",
  "categoryOther": "Inception Phase",
  "vendorIds": ["{{vendorId}}"],
  "startDate": "2026-05-01T09:00:00Z",
  "endDate": "2026-12-31T17:00:00Z"
}

request.description: Create a project with category='others'. categoryOther is REQUIRED and non-empty when category='others'; it must be omitted for any other category.

Idempotent create-or-update keyed by UUID (wizard flow). The frontend generates the UUID once per wizard session via crypto.randomUUID(). 201 on first call, 200 on subsequent calls. On update, the caller must own the project (or be admin).
List projects (soft-deleted rows are filtered out by default)
Fetch a project by UUID. 404 if soft-deleted.

Only whitelisted fields are applied: name, description, owner, start_date, end_date, public, active, status_explanation (on unpublished baselines). Versions allow only owner, public, actual_end_date, status_explanation. Anything else returns 422 invalid_field. Sending vendorIds replaces the full list; omit to leave it unchanged; send [] to clear.
Maps to the Step-1 wizard 'Save Project' button. Flips status from 'new' to 'draft' when at least one live milestone exists on the project. Without milestones: 422. Idempotent once past 'new'.
Publish the project. Transitions status to 'published'. After this, PATCH returns 409 project_locked and any writes into the subtree return 403.
Close the project. reason is optional; when provided it is stored in status_explanation.
Suspend a version project (only works when isVersion=true). Terminal — suspended versions do not come back. Frees the active-version slot so a new version can be created from the baseline.

Clone a published baseline into a fresh version. Source must have isVersion=false AND status='published'. Response includes new id, new projectCode, isVersion=true, baselineId=source. Only ONE active (non-suspended, non-deleted) version per baseline is allowed.

Soft-delete a project. When the target is a BASELINE (isVersion=false), every live version of it is soft-deleted too, and each one's M/A/T/S subtree is cascaded. Deleting a version alone leaves the baseline and siblings live. One transaction — no partial state.

Full M/A/T/S tree under a project: milestones -> activities -> tasks -> subtasks, with resource details inlined for resource-type rows. Soft-deleted rows are filtered unless includeDeleted=true (admin practice).

item.name: Milestones
item.description: Milestones live under projects. Carry status (not_completed | completed), an optional depends list (pass-through), and an optional vendor subset (must be a subset of the parent project's vendors).

request.description: Create a milestone. startDate must be >= project.startDate. vendorIds must be a subset of the project's vendor list.
List milestones under a project (sorted by position, then id).
Fetch a single milestone by UUID.
Partial update. Sending vendorIds replaces the full list; omit to leave unchanged; send [] to clear. status must be one of not_completed, completed.
Soft-delete a milestone and every descendant (activities, their resources, tasks, their resources, subtasks, their resources). One transaction.
Restore a soft-deleted milestone. Does NOT auto-restore descendants.

item.name: Activities
item.description: Activities live under milestones. type is one of 'standard' (status + dependency apply), 'resource' (resourceMode + resource block apply), or 'transactional' (no extras).

request.description: Create a standard activity. status defaults to 'not_completed'. dependency is a pass-through list (no referential integrity yet). status + dependency are ONLY valid when type='standard'.
Transactional activity. status / dependency / resource* fields must all be absent.
Resource activity in 'count' mode. Just a headcount — no inline resource block.
Resource activity, details mode. typeOfResourceId is REQUIRED and must reference an active row in /resource_types. division is one of tmd1, tmd2, others. Here: tmd1.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "A5 — Special Projects engineer",
  "type": "resource",
  "startDate": "2026-05-10T09:00:00Z",
  "endDate": "2026-07-31T17:00:00Z",
  "resourceMode": "details",
  "resource": {
    "resourceName": "Bob Pereira",
    "jobRole": "Integration Lead",
    "experienceYears": 8,
    "typeOfResourceId": "{{resourceTypeId}}",
    "division": "others",
    "divisionOther": "Beta Program"
  }
}

request.description: Resource activity with division='others'. divisionOther is REQUIRED and non-empty. For any non-'others' division, divisionOther must be omitted.
List activities under a milestone. The inline resource block is not included on list — use GET /activities/{id} for that.
Fetch one activity, with its resource block inlined when present.

Partial update. Handles type transitions (standard <-> resource <-> transactional). When leaving type=standard, status + dependency are cleared. When entering type=resource/details, typeOfResourceId and division become required.
Soft-delete an activity and its descendants + resources. One transaction.
Restore a soft-deleted activity.

item.name: Tasks
item.description: Tasks live under activities. Same shape as activities re: type / resourceMode / resource block.

request.description: Create a task under an activity. Dates must fit within the parent activity's window.
List tasks under an activity.
Fetch one task.
Partial update.
Soft-delete a task and its subtasks + resources.
Restore a soft-deleted task.

item.name: Subtasks
item.description: Subtasks live under tasks. Same shape as activities/tasks.

request.description: Create a subtask under a task. Note: typeOfResourceId + division are currently scoped to activities' resources, not subtasks' (the subtasks module exposes the same ResourcePayload shape but the extra classification columns live only on activity_resources).
List subtasks under a task.
Fetch one subtask.
Partial update.
Soft-delete a subtask + its resource.
Restore a soft-deleted subtask.
